display_name: M3DB / M3 (Uber M3 Coordinator, M3 Query, M3 Aggregator)

default_port_notes.7201: PRIMARY — M3 Coordinator HTTP API. Fronts placement/namespace CRUD and Prometheus remote-write ingestion. Unauthenticated by default.
default_port_notes.7203: Coordinator metrics endpoint (Prometheus self-scrape) — exact default conflicts between doc examples (0.0.0.0:3030 in admin-mode doc vs 7203 in common deployment convention). Config-dependent, verify per-target.
default_port_notes.9000: M3DB node client (TChannel/Thrift) — cluster read/write RPC.
default_port_notes.9003_9004: Additional node ports seen only in kube/bundle.yaml and m3dbnode-statefulset.yaml manifests, NOT independently confirmed in prose docs — debug/pprof vs additional RPC purpose unconfirmed.

auth_default: NO AUTH BY DESIGN — not merely off-by-default, structurally absent. Official FAQ/architecture docs and the m3query config struct (src/cmd/services/m3query/config/config.go) confirm M3DB has no access control of any kind: no users, no roles/permissions, no TLS/auth/API-key fields in the config struct at all. Recommended mitigation is operator-added reverse proxy — opt-in infrastructure, not a shipped toggle.
install_tell: Official K8s manifests (github.com/m3db/m3 kube/bundle.yaml, kube/m3dbnode-statefulset.yaml): StatefulSet m3dbnode + Deployment m3coordinator, clusterManagement via etcd (or noop-etcd for single-node admin mode)
misconfig_patterns: 7201 exposed to 0.0.0.0/internet with no reverse-proxy auth layer — this is the default/undocumented-as-risky state, not a deviation from default
/api/v1/prom/remote/write reachable unauth -> arbitrary metric injection / storage exhaustion / cardinality-bomb DoS
/api/v1/services/m3db/namespace and /placement reachable unauth -> full namespace/placement enumeration and mutation (create/delete namespaces = data-destructive)
/api/v1/database/create reachable unauth -> attacker can provision new namespaces/placements, resource-exhaustion or topology pivot
noop-etcd 'admin mode' instances left running in prod — docs explicitly frame this as dev/single-node convenience, not hardened
node ports 9000-9002 reachable outside coordinator/cluster network — should be internal-only, coordinator is the intended public-ish edge

passive: GET / or GET /api/v1/services/m3db/namespace on 7201 returning JSON with registry.namespaces keys
M3-prefixed custom headers (M3-Metrics-Type, M3-Storage-Policy, M3-Restrict-By-Tags-JSON) on POST responses to /api/v1/prom/remote/write

pivot_paths: Namespace/placement enumeration (GET /api/v1/services/m3db/namespace) -> full topology + retention policy disclosure, no auth required
Remote-write injection (POST /api/v1/prom/remote/write) -> forge/poison metrics data, potential downstream dashboard/alerting manipulation
Query API data read (/api/v1/query, /query_range, /graphite/render) -> read all stored time-series data unauth — the core auth-off-default finding for this platform
Database/namespace create-delete -> destructive: attacker can delete production namespaces or provision resource-exhausting new ones
Node-level 9002/health + 9000/9001 if exposed -> cluster topology/liveness fingerprinting, secondary to coordinator's richer unauth surface
vulnerabilities: NO CVEs or GHSA advisories found for m3db/m3/m3query/m3coordinator (GitHub Advisory Database query 'm3db' = 0 results). Explicit null result, not a gap — consistent with a threat model that never claimed to have auth to bypass. The exposure is a design-default/misconfiguration class finding, not a patchable CVE.
auth_default_thesis: STRONGEST CONFIRMATION IN THE CATEGORY. M3DB/M3Coordinator ships with zero authentication, authorization, or access-control mechanism in the open-source binary — the config struct itself has no auth fields to misconfigure. This is starker than most category peers where auth exists but defaults off (VictoriaMetrics, InfluxDB v1): here there is nothing to toggle at all, 100% of the auth burden sits on the operator to bolt on a reverse proxy.
